description: This earthquake-detection benchmark pairs social-media images with semantic-segmentation annotations. Henan University of Science and Technology and partner researchers publish 1,000 original input images with corresponding targets and an augmented set of 10,000 inputs and targets, each at 512 by 512 pixels. The stated source period is 2020–2022. The ScienceDB repository provides JPG and PNG data with CC BY 4.0 for free reuse. The collection can test image-based damage information used in emergency-response simulations. Augmented images are not independent events, and social-media selection does not represent a complete inventory of affected buildings. Geographic locations and damage-label meanings require checking before spatial exposure analysis. No directly related catalogue resource was identified.
name: A dataset of semantic segmentation in earthquake disaster detection based on social media images
notes: G4-0085; G4 other data journals. Metadata only. Simulation uses are reviewer assessments. Data payloads and code execution were not checked.
